units.source_text: 天黑了，侍女们拿灯火来，源氏公子便和紫姬在灯下看画。

en.t: When it grew dark, the ladies-in-waiting brought in lamps, and Prince Genji looked at pictures with Lady Murasaki beneath the light.

units.source_text: 先前说过今晚要赴左大臣邸，此时随从人等便在门外作咳嗽声，并说：“天要下雨了。”

en.t: Since he had earlier said that he would go to the Left Minister's mansion that night, his attendants now coughed outside the gate and said, "It looks as though it will rain."

units.source_text: 催促源氏公子早点动身。

en.t: They were urging Prince Genji to set out soon.

units.source_text: 紫姬听见了，照例不高兴起来，双眉紧锁。

en.t: Lady Murasaki heard them and, as usual, became unhappy, her brows tightly drawn together.

units.source_text: 她画也不要看了，低头不语，样子实在可爱。

en.t: She no longer wanted to look at the pictures, and sat with her head lowered in silence, looking truly lovely.

units.source_text: 她的头发浓重艳丽，源氏公子用手替她拢拢垂下的发绺，问道：“我出门了你想念我么？”

en.t: Her hair was thick and beautiful, and Prince Genji gently smoothed the hanging locks with his hand and asked, "Will you miss me when I go out?"

units.source_text: 紫姬点点头。

en.t: Lady Murasaki nodded.

units.source_text: 公子说：“我也是一日不看见你便不快乐的。

en.t: The prince said, "I too am unhappy if I do not see you even for one day.

units.source_text: 不过我想，你现在年纪还小，我可以无所顾虑。

en.t: But I think that because you are still so young, I need have no worries about you.

units.source_text: 我首先要顾到那几个脾气固执、善于嫉妒的人，希望不伤害她们的感情。

en.t: First I must consider those few stubborn and jealous women, and I hope not to hurt their feelings.

units.source_text: 她们要向我噜，所以我暂且到她们那里走走。

en.t: They will complain to me, so for the time being I shall go and visit them.

units.source_text: 将来你长大了，我决不再常常出门。

en.t: When you grow up in the future, I will certainly no longer go out so often.

units.source_text: 我不要教人恨我，为的是想长命康乐，如意称心地和你两人过日子呀。”

en.t: I do not want to make anyone hate me, because I wish to live long and peacefully, and spend my days happily and contentedly with you alone."

units.source_text: 这番话说得体贴入微，紫姬听了也不免难以为情。

en.t: These words were spoken with such delicate consideration that Lady Murasaki, hearing them, could not help feeling embarrassed.

units.source_text: 她一句话也不回答，就靠在源氏公子的膝上睡着了。

en.t: She did not answer a word, but leaned against Prince Genji's knee and fell asleep.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得很可怜，便吩咐随从人等：“今夜不出门了。”

en.t: Prince Genji felt deeply sorry for her and told his attendants, "I shall not go out tonight."

units.source_text: 随从者各自散去。

en.t: The attendants each dispersed.

units.source_text: 侍女们将公子的膳食送到这里来请用。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting brought the prince's meal there and invited him to eat.

units.source_text: 公子唤起紫姬，对她说：“我不出门了！”

en.t: The prince woke Lady Murasaki and said to her, "I am not going out!"

units.source_text: 紫姬闻言，心中欢乐，便起身了。

en.t: When Lady Murasaki heard this, joy filled her heart, and she sat up.

units.source_text: 两人一起用晚饭。

en.t: The two of them ate supper together.

units.source_text: 紫姬吃得很少，略略举箸，应名而已。

en.t: Lady Murasaki ate very little, merely lifting her chopsticks a little for form's sake.

units.source_text: 饭后紫姬对公子说：“那么您就早点睡吧。”

en.t: After the meal, Lady Murasaki said to the prince, "Then please go to bed early."

units.source_text: 她还是不放心，生怕公子出门。

en.t: She still could not feel at ease, fearing that the prince might go out.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：恁般可爱的人儿，我即使是赴阴司，也难于抛舍她而独行的。

en.t: Prince Genji thought: With someone this dear, even if I were going to the underworld, I could hardly abandon her and go alone.
